# tisplay

> See and control a computer's desktop from your terminal, including over SSH.

- Project site: https://pkyanam.github.io/tisplay/
- Source, issues, releases: https://github.com/pkyanam/tisplay
- Human installation and usage: https://github.com/pkyanam/tisplay#readme
- Agent quickstart: https://github.com/pkyanam/tisplay/blob/main/docs/agents/quickstart.md
- Agent CLI contract and JSON actions: https://github.com/pkyanam/tisplay/blob/main/docs/agents/protocol.md
- Current internal JSONL envelope schema (v1; CLI remains the supported public interface): https://github.com/pkyanam/tisplay/blob/main/schemas/agent-v1.schema.json
- Agent examples: https://github.com/pkyanam/tisplay/tree/main/docs/agents/examples
- Security policy: https://github.com/pkyanam/tisplay/blob/main/SECURITY.md

The installed `tisplay --help` and `tisplay capabilities --json` are authoritative for the current CLI and backend. Direct Wayland capture and virtual desktop resize are unsupported. On Linux, virtual sessions use Xvfb/XFCE; macOS requires a logged-in desktop and permissions.
